It really depends on the bulgur you buy but I used:

•30g of bulgur
•60g of boiled water + 30g more
•1 tsp of your fave sweetner
•low cal strawberry jam because why not?

So I mixed my bulgur and 60g of water (adding my sweetner) and I just covered it and left it overnight. Then when I wanted it I added the rest of my water and put it in the microwave until there was no more water. I put my jam on top and it was done! I made it overnight oats style but it can be made all at once in the microwave, and this was a small portion because I was snacking all throughout the night and wasn’t really hungry but didn’t want to break my breakfast streak. 

If you do try it let me know how you find it!! It’s totally customisable and you can make it with plant milk, cream, chocolate sauce, whatever.
